request.query: Binary image of two sets under an arbitrary function, with membership expressed by two bounded existential quantifiers

items.name: Set.mem_image2_of_mem
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} {f : α → β → γ} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {a : α} {b : β},
  a ∈ s → b ∈ t → f a b ∈ Set.image2 f s t

items.name: Set.mem_image2
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} {f : α → β → γ} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {c : γ},
  c ∈ Set.image2 f s t ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ ∃ b, b ∈ t ∧ f a b = c

items.name: Set.image2
items.type: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → {γ : Type w} → (α → β → γ) → Set α → Set β → Set γ

items.name: Finset.mem_image₂
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} [inst : DecidableEq γ] {f : α → β → γ} {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β}
  {c : γ}, c ∈ Finset.image₂ f s t ↔ ∃ a ∈ s, ∃ b ∈ t, f a b = c

items.name: Set.exists_mem_image2
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} {f : α → β → γ} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {p : γ → Prop},
  (∃ z, z ∈ Set.image2 f s t ∧ p z) ↔ ∃ x, x ∈ s ∧ ∃ y, y ∈ t ∧ p (f x y)

items.name: Set.image
items.type: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → (α → β) → Set α → Set β
